description: This file defines a React functional component named Sidebar that provides a navigation sidebar for student users within a learning management system. It displays the application brand, the user's email, and a list of navigation links to different sections of the platform. The component utilizes React Router for navigation behavior and contextual authentication data to access the current user's email.

methods.name: Sidebar()
methods.description: React functional component that renders a sidebar with navigation links, brand name, and user email display.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Helper function that checks if a given route matches the current location pathname, used to determine the active navigation item.
